messages:
Alex: heads up — PR #21177 is green locally but CI shows intermittent failure on linux-shard3 for telemetry-metrics-test. Snapshot diff only in the metrics JSON. Anyone seen this pattern?

Maria: @Alex can you paste the diff or failing log? want to see which metric changed.

Alex: pasted below, the snapshot delta is a timestamp-ish field called `ingest_latency_p50` that jumps by ~10ms in CI but not locally.
```
FAIL: telemetry-metrics-test
--- expected
"ingest_latency_p50": 23
+++ actual
"ingest_latency_p50": 34
```

Sam: hmmm looks like nondet due to perf noise. shard3 runs on a smaller instance, we had similar flakiness last month. Could be startup scheduling. 

Jen: if it's perf noise we should avoid snapshot updates. I'd prefer a targeted rerun on shard3 first and then decide. Can someone trigger a rerun? @CI Bot ?

CI Bot: buildkite: Triggered targeted rerun for job telemetry-metrics-test on linux-shard3 (build 5021) — queued

Alex: thanks — also FYI the test reads ENV VAR `METRICS_SAMPLE_SEED`. I left it unset locally which might stabilize behavior. Maybe CI sets it differently.

Maria: if seed is involved then test should set it explicitly. Can you add a small change to the test to fix the seed and push a tiny patch to this PR? That will make it deterministic.

Sam: +1 to setting seed. Short-term rerun, medium-term update test to set stable seed. Also adding a retry in CI for that shard is OK if we need a quick unblock.

Jen: timeline: we need this merged before the noon release window (2h). If rerun passes and Alex adds a seed tweak in the next 20m, I'll approve and merge. If rerun still flakes, hold merge and we'll prioritize a hotfix.

Alex: I'll push a one-line seed fix now and re-run. pinging when done.

Alex: pushed `testTelemetry.setSeed(42)` and retriggered buildkite targeted rerun.

CI Bot: buildkite: Re-run completed — status: passed on linux-shard3 for telemetry-metrics-test (build 5022)

Maria: nice. good call setting seed. please include a comment explaining why for future readers.

Jen: reviewed the small test change, LGTM. @Alex you can merge after CI is green across all shards.

Alex: merging now, thanks all :rocket:

Sam: :tada: good teamwork
